title: Bumblebee in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#bfeaff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-20 38 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#bfeaff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(20 62 30)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <rect x='30' y='48' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <rect x='27' y='60' width='46' height='6' rx='3' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='32' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x='33' y='40' width='34' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff5577'/>
  <path d='M62 44 L74 56 L68 58 L58 47 Z' fill='#ff5577'/>
  <path d='M62 44 L74 56 L71 59 L60 47 Z' fill='#ff88aa' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='13' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 38 Q50 42 55 38' stroke='#5a2a00' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='45' y1='22' x2='41' y2='14' stroke='#5a2a00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='13' r='2.5' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='22' x2='59' y2='14' stroke='#5a2a00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='13' r='2.5' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 80 L47 88 L53 88 Z' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <!-- little legs -->
  <line x1='36' y1='66' x2='28' y2='74' stroke='#5a2a00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='66' x2='72' y2='74' stroke='#5a2a00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
